responsibility: Provides the high-level design specification for gccrs’s Borrow-checker IR (BIR), the Rust-frontend-only control-flow representation used to feed Polonius rather than GCC code generation. It explains why BIR exists alongside GENERIC/GIMPLE, describes the core function/basic-block/place/statement model, documents how locals, paths, borrows, and control-flow terminators are represented, and defines the intended MIR-like textual dump shape that neighboring builder and dump files implement.
